clues.text: This city sits in hill country, where a river winds past lakes, springs, and falls. The land lifts and dips in low hills all through the town.
clues.narrowing: Rules out flat coast towns; puts the player in hill country on a river with springs.

source.quote: it is home to numerous lakes, rivers, and waterways, including Lady Bird Lake and Lake Travis on the Colorado River

clues.text: Summers here are long and very hot, and winters are short and mild. Yet a sudden cold burst, called a Blue Norther, can strike fast.
clues.narrowing: Rules out steady climates; keeps long hot summers with sudden winter cold bursts.

source.quote: This climate is typified by long, very hot summers, short, mild winters, and warm to hot spring and fall seasons in-between

clues.text: In 1839, the young republic sent a team to seek a site for a fresh capital. They chose this river spot, and a planned town was born.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals picked by a search team in 1839 for a young republic.

source.quote: In 1839, the Texas Congress formed a commission to seek a site for the new capital of the Republic of Texas to replace Houston

clues.text: The world's largest city bat colony lives under a bridge in this city. Mother bats raise their pups there from mid-summer to fall.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: one city hosts the world's largest urban bat colony under a bridge.

source.article: Ann W. Richards Congress Avenue Bridge
source.quote: The bridge currently serves as a habitat for the world's largest urban bat colony

clues.text: Texas laws are made in the capitol in this city. The governor of the state works here too.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the state capitol building and seat of government are in this city.

source.quote: became a center for government and education with the construction of the Texas State Capitol

reveal.blurb: In 1839, a site by the river was picked for a fresh capital, and the village first called Waterloo was laid out there. Today mother bats raise their pups under a bridge while lawmakers meet in the state capitol: the building is the capitol, and the city is the capital. Austin is the capital of Texas.
